This game is one of the worst balanced cardgames which i have ever seen. You can put cards from your deck into inventory to get an extremely small deck by the early midgame. You can play a ton of cards with exhaust to shrink your deck even more. Cards which draw a bunch can draw themselves again. The game is very liberal with mana restoration effects. After a run you can even put some of your cards into storage to get them against next run. The result: easy infinites for everyone.

视觉效果比较乱也好，bug比较多也好，其实都不是特别关键（当然挺多bug都很严重，品控确实不行）。关键是你作为卡牌游戏的可重玩性不够强。 卡包与角色分离，一方面玩新角色的动力很低（因为只有技能差别），另一方面你总共就这么几个卡包还都要解锁，要解锁的卡包里强度又显著弱于初始卡包（或者换句话说就是元素和唤神太强了，而其他所有体系都远远跟不上强度），这就导致构筑同质化严重。再加上有几乎稳定的回费手段，只要拿到过牌就能无限（还因此导致过牌卡数量极少，在主教披风和敏锐全都因bug不生效的情况下，非无限体系极度缺乏过牌），构筑复杂度进一步降低。而这一方面导致小怪全是减速带，另一方面导致最终boss不得不设计堪比门扉的恶心机制和免伤等来避免被秒，在攻杀极度容易的时候又让攻杀没法玩只能找生存，这还有什么策略性可言呢。 总而言之，当我重来一局游戏时，新解锁卡包的牌因为太菜越拿越弱最好不要拿，路上全是减速带不需要考虑，抓牌只考虑本轮的最终boss要应对什么机制，那这到底有什么重来一遍的必要呢？

I refunded but could see myself buying again and maybe changing my review depending on how it develops. Before I say anything about the game I need to point out that this game really should have the "early access" label/warning on it. If you play the demo you'll notice that about 30% of the cards aren't translated which is mostly fixed in the full version but there are still some untranslated UI elements and the translation is quite rough. Some keywords are inconsistent (your magic stat is called mana sometimes) and the dialogue felt nonsensical. Having these things in a early access game would be more understandable and it really feels like the developers are treating the game as if it's in early access. The full version also has a very different main hub than the demo so when you purchase the game you'll be surprised to see that they traded the somewhat charming pixel art base for a generic background image with some clickable objects that looks like it belongs to a crappy anime browser game from the early 2010s. The way this version of the main hub works is also really weird but I don't feel like getting into it. Now the developers have thankfully stated that they're going to move back to the pixel art style but once again this is more like something you do in a early access than a full release. Because of these reason I cannot recommend the game in it's current state but I do think it's worth keeping an eye on if you like this type of game. If you can tolerate some of this jankiness the game might be worth it for you even as it is currently.
